Verdict: OBJECT for SourceRef Phase 1 at the exact head below.
Head: ae270aa084446d455215d3884b24d908701e376d.
Tree: a108b7f049555e89725bdaa7c88d28c63ce0dfd2.
Base: 6cf742491de8a6ca5555ca045c49197575cfa8bf.
Mote: bd-01M3EXX8KSK97QEKXSZ43DTVYV in the approved branch-local codex-source-ref/.mote store. Fray #32.

[P2] Enforce checked interpretation compatibility before constructing declared evidence.
plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/SourceIdentity.scala:26-28 exposes an unchecked Declared(format,parser,options) constructor. codec/src/main/scala/eyes4s/codec/SourceIdentityCodec.scala:83-110 parses these independently and checks only that their combined digest matches. A FixationCsv declaration can therefore name the known trial-inventory parser. The writer computes a matching identity for the incompatible combination, and the reader can reconstruct it as declared evidence. This violates the approved sketch's checked format/parser/options-schema compatibility, explicitly adopted by #2 @13 and reconfirmed by driver #32 @211. The problem is inconsistent declared interpretation, not a claim that it becomes replay-verified. Require checked construction and route codec decoding through it; include compatible typed options/schema evidence and refuse incompatible built-in combinations with located errors.

[P2] Refuse unsupported key descriptions before reporting successful encoding.
codec/src/main/scala/eyes4s/codec/ImportSpecCodec.scala:217-219 writes any value.keys without checking the codec's accepted key kind, whereas :249-250 rejects a noncustom kind for custom(). ImportSpecCodec.custom[StudyKey,Px](StudyCodecs.key(DefinitionId.studyKey)) accepts a built-in Study ImportSpec at its static type. Its encode returns success, but its own decode rejects keys.kind=study with expected custom, found study. Reject unsupported kind during encode, narrow its accepted domain, or support symmetric decoding. Add a writer-domain regression distinct from the existing valid-custom roundtrip.

Independent tests in .claude/worktrees/review-source-ref-ae270aa:
- codec/src/test/scala/eyes4s/codec/SourceRefIndependentReviewSuite.scala: incompatible declaration refusal, codec writer-domain roundtrip, legacy remains undeclared.
- io/src/test/scala/eyes4s/io/SourceAdmissionIndependentReviewSuite.scala: equivalent quoting/CRLF retains complete source identity and rejection accounting; identical CSV bytes interpreted in milliseconds versus seconds changes actual admitted input and options identity.

Command: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true sbt -J-Xmx8g 'ioJVM/testOnly *SourceAdmissionIndependentReviewSuite *SourceAdmissionSuite' 'codecJVM/testOnly *SourceRefIndependentReviewSuite *ImportSpecSuite *SchemaCompatibilitySuite'
Receipt: /private/tmp/eyes4s-source-ref-independent-review/focused.log and .log.meta.json. Exit 1; 26 total tests, 24 passed, 2 failed, none ignored. All 6 importer tests passed (2 independent, 4 existing). Codec: all 5 ImportSpecSuite and 12 SchemaCompatibilitySuite cases passed; the independent legacy baseline passed, and both counterexamples failed their required expectations. The first returned Right(SourceRef(...,Declared(FixationCsv,DefinitionId(eyes4s.trial-inventory-csv-parser,1),...))); the second returned Field(kind,...,expected custom, found study) when decoding its successful encode output.

Scope reviewed: ImportSpec, SourceIdentity, StudyInputEvidence changes; ImportSpecCodec, SourceIdentityCodec, StudyInputCodec v1-v4 ladder and InventoryWire; SourceAdmission and FixationCsv extraction with existing key/parser/evidence/inventory callers; identity laws, fixtures, registrations and changed documentation. No additional source objection identified in identity-first comparison/exact nonempty causes, explicit legacy handling, importer record accounting, or identity sensitivity within this bounded review. Author mutation receipts report five killed mutants; this review did not independently rerun those mutations.

Limits: focused JVM source review, not full acceptance. Full author gates and API audit are not independently certified here; no publishing consumer, manifest roles, later replay branch, Phase2 importers, JS or Studio qualification. No author/main source edits, merge, push, acceptance change, or UI-D changes. Independent reproducers/local sbt workaround only in the detached review copy. Verdict applies only to the specified head/tree.
